contracts.name: Director Coordination Boundary
contracts.rule: The Director MAY classify, decompose, match and delegate work but MUST NOT self-authorize security, resources, models, tools, durable lifecycle or evidence.

contracts.name: Competency and Anti-Capability
contracts.rule: Every selectable specialist MUST declare strong/supported capabilities, anti-capabilities, authority scope and prohibited authority roles.

contracts.name: Hard Filters Before Scoring
contracts.rule: Domain, anti-capability, authority, security, resource, conformance and activation filters MUST execute before preference or AI-assisted ranking.

contracts.name: Durable Lifecycle Singularity
contracts.rule: Temporal remains the sole global durable workflow lifecycle authority. Other workflow providers MAY own delegated local execution state only.

contracts.name: Resource Authority
contracts.rule: GPU/NPU/CPU/RAM/VRAM/NUMA placement and admission are governed by FA3 HRB; accelerator conflicts are mediated by ACCEL-GUARD with RECOMMEND as default.

contracts.name: Human Escalation
contracts.rule: Ambiguous, consequential or conflicting decisions MUST be escalated to the user unless an explicit prior user policy authorizes automatic action.

contracts.name: Provider-Neutral Plan IR
contracts.rule: Canonical cross-domain plans MUST use FA3-owned provider-neutral contracts. CrewAI, Temporal, Conductor, LangGraph, OMA, Kestra, Pipecat, n8n and Haystack native objects are adapter outputs only.

contracts.name: Promotion Evidence
contracts.rule: A design-accepted specialist with PENDING_CURRENT_HOST status MUST NOT be selected for runtime execution that requires current-host promotion.

contracts.name: Independent Security and Evidence
contracts.rule: A specialist MUST NOT approve its own security policy, evidence sufficiency, release promotion or authority expansion.

contracts.name: Deterministic Fallback
contracts.rule: Fallback selection MUST repeat the same hard filters; fallback status MUST NOT bypass anti-capabilities, authority boundaries or runtime evidence.

contracts.name: Unified Action Fabric Execution Boundary
contracts.rule: Agent, GUI, CLI, MCP, A2A and automation initiated orchestration execution MUST enter through FA3-UNIFIED-ACTION-FABRIC-001. The Workforce and provider SPI MUST NOT become direct provider execution authorities.

contracts.name: Bounded Decision Fabric Advisory
contracts.rule: Decision Fabric MAY advise specialist ranking only after deterministic eligibility filtering, MUST NOT add candidates, grant permission, admit providers, obtain resources or become final policy authority.

contracts.name: Human-Auditable AI Communication
contracts.rule: All model-to-model and agent-to-agent communication crossing the workforce boundary MUST conform to FA3-AI-COMMS-001 with authoritative human-readable semantics; private model languages, emergent codebooks and model-only slang are forbidden.

contracts.name: Closed AI Participant Topology
contracts.rule: A specialist or provider MUST NOT add models, agents or providers outside the application's pre-authorized AI participant set. Model/provider/runtime routing remains FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 authority.

contracts.name: Horizontal Hardware and Resource Boundary
contracts.rule: Hardware discovery is provider-neutral and non-authoritative; HRB remains the exclusive host-resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority. HRB is not a workforce specialist provider.

contracts.name: Evidence-Bound Runtime Admission
contracts.rule: Static provider status is informative only. External runtime execution requires a provider- and scope-bound CURRENT_HOST_PRODUCTION_E2E_PASS admission receipt with runtime identity evidence; no receipt means fail closed.

contracts.name: Objective-to-Work Traceability
contracts.rule: Every governed task MAY carry objective ancestry; the ancestry MUST remain non-authoritative context and MUST be preserved in monitoring/audit projections.

contracts.name: Minimal Qualified Decomposition
contracts.rule: A separate subtask MUST have a real owner, permission, parallel-deliverable, hard dependency/handoff, independent review/approval, or retry/recovery boundary.

contracts.name: Typed Dependency Separation
contracts.rule: Parent/child structure MUST NOT be treated as an execution blocker. Hard dependency relations MUST be explicit and cycle-free.

contracts.name: Monotonic Delegation Scope
contracts.rule: Every delegated responsibility/claim scope MUST be equal to or narrower than its parent scope.

contracts.name: Execution Claim Safety
contracts.rule: Runtime claims MUST be task-bound, generation-bound and idempotency-bound. Stale heartbeat alone MUST NOT authorize takeover.

contracts.name: Version-Bound Approval
contracts.rule: Effectful approval MUST bind exact object identity, revision, digest, scope and operation; changed objects require fresh approval.

contracts.name: Bounded Execution Budget
contracts.rule: Coordination budgets MUST be bounded/non-negative and MUST NOT grant HRB, provider, model or security authority.

contracts.name: Liveness Separation
contracts.rule: Liveness state, Temporal durable state and canonical evidence verification MUST remain separately represented.

contracts.name: Monitoring and Reconfiguration Boundary
contracts.rule: Monitoring MAY project state and submit governed change requests but MUST NOT directly mutate protected authorities or silently switch runtime engines.

contracts.name: Bounded Recovery and No Blind Replay
contracts.rule: Unknown effect outcome MUST block blind replay; recovery MUST be bounded, idempotent and revalidate current authorization/leases/approvals.

contracts.name: Canonical Task-Group Eligibility
contracts.rule: When a work request declares a task group, it MUST resolve through FA3-TASK-GROUP-REGISTRY-001 before specialist ranking. Unknown or invalid task groups fail closed.

contracts.name: Task-Group Authority Isolation
contracts.rule: AUTHORITY_BOUND task groups MUST NOT be routed as workforce specialist authority; orchestration requests the owning horizontal authority instead.

contracts.name: Ordered Guard-Chain Projection
contracts.rule: FA3-ORCHESTRATION-GUARD-CHAIN-CONTRACTS-001 defines the non-authoritative G0-G10 validation order. Guard projection MUST NOT mint authority decisions.

contracts.name: Workload Mode Intent Boundary
contracts.rule: Task-group workload-mode policy is intent/state context only. With FA3 present, HRB remains the exclusive physical resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.
